remarks: Welcome to this spacious 4-bedroom, 3-full-bath home located in the highly desirable Village of Allegany! Offering a versatile layout with plenty of room for family and guests, this home combines comfort, convenience, and functionality. The first floor features a bright eat-in kitchen with direct access to the covered patio, perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or entertaining. Just off the kitchen is a welcoming living room offering plenty of space to relax and gather. The first-floor primary suite provides added privacy and convenience with an en suite bathroom featuring a Jacuzzi tub, dual 5-foot walk-in shower, and double vanity. With a second primary suite located upstairs, the first-floor suite also offers great flexibility and could easily be converted into additional living space, a family room, home office, or whatever best suits your needs. First-floor laundry and an attached 2-car garage add even more everyday convenience. Upstairs you'll find three generously sized bedrooms, including the second primary suite with its own private full bathroom—an excellent setup for guests, extended family, or multi-generational living. An additional full bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms. Other highlights include a 3-zone hot water boiler system for customizable heating, durable vinyl siding, and a low-maintenance metal roof. Conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping, and everything the Village of Allegany has to offer, this home provides an impressive amount of space, flexibility, and functionality in a great location.
